notes: Reference is the actual supplied PARSE label, not a supplemented version or self-comparison.
Three-case descriptive results only; no population significance, confidence intervals, or generalization claim.
Macro means weight each valid case equally. Sample SD uses n-1 and is null for n<2. Min/max are per-case extremes.
Undefined metrics, including empty-surface HD95, stay null. Each metric reports valid, undefined, failed, missing, pending, and stale counts.
Do not interpret an HD95 mean without its valid n and the empty/failure counts; excluded undefined distances are not successful zero-distance cases.
Dice/clDice/NSD/Precision/Recall/IoU and largest-component fractions are 0-1, HD95 is mm, volumes are mL.
CC26 accepts face/edge/corner contacts; connected-component measurements do not establish anatomical correctness.
NSD is not pooled across different tolerances. Training-set independence of these cases has not been verified.
Completed server inference records and uploaded CT digests are verified; pending/failed inference and changed provenance are excluded.

report.interpretation: Segmentation evaluated against the supplied reference label; not before/after annotation agreement. Three-case results are descriptive and do not establish population performance or training-set independence.

label_semantics.prediction: binary lung_arteries output of the declared TotalSegmentator lung_vessels task

memory_cropping.reason: Only shared background removed; all foreground and original spacing preserved
memory_cropping.confusion_count_extent: Entire original grid, computed before cropping

protocol.CC26: face, edge, or corner contact; largest fraction is descriptive, not anatomical accuracy

protocol.implementation: independent fixed protocol, not VesMamba authors code
protocol.NSD: surfel-area weighted surface Dice, inclusive distance <= tolerance
protocol.HD95: max of directional area-weighted 95th percentiles, surface-distance 0.1, mm
protocol.clDice: 3D Lee skeleton, voxel-count precision/sensitivity, no pruning
protocol.postprocessing: none; union bbox crop removes only shared background, then zero padding
protocol.empty_policy: both empty=null; one empty overlap metrics=0, HD95=null with failure status
